cuts: no open limps except the small blind's

realisation.source: fitted to turn+river solves (flop checked) of the charts' own heads-up ranges; docs/CHARTS.md §4
realisation.multiway: share_p = x_p + (1 - Σx)/n, x_p = Π_q s_pq

realisationFit.method: rounds of: solve the preflop game; solve sampled turn+river spots (flop checked) between the charts' heads-up ranges; fit the realisation model's coefficients to the shares realised

solver.algorithm: DCFR, alternating updates, 169 classes per player
solver.offRange: classes whose stored range is 0 (< 0.5/255) get the best response to the charts (argmax EV)

convergence.note: Multi-player CFR has no equilibrium guarantee; NashConv is the sum over players of what a best response would gain against the others' average strategies (0 at a Nash equilibrium of this model).

excluded.rule: nodes reached less often than 0.00001, and nodes where the chart's own mix loses more than 2% of the pot for a class in range
